name: BNLI: A Linguistically-Refined Bengali Dataset for Natural Language Inference
description: BNLI is a linguistically curated, human-validated Natural Language Inference (NLI) dataset for Bengali. Presented at the CHiPSAL 2026 workshop at LREC, it consists of 12,600 balanced sentence pairs evenly distributed across entailment, contradiction, and neutral classes (4,200 pairs each), addressing syntactic diversity and annotation consistency in Indic NLI evaluation.
